submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular portrait PARTS atlas for a Taoist chibi game. Attached1/2 define fine HD handpainted jade/ivory/warmgold style. Attached3 is adopted finished portrait painting. Attached4 is the exact BLANK front-facing head family to fit. All components front-facing with same scale and pose, no perspective rotation. EXACT4columns x3rows12 separate portrait accessories, no heads/body/skin. Row1 FOUR frontal necktie/neckpendant pieces [jade silk ribbon knot withlongtails;ivory silkcravat withgoldpin;roundyin-yang jade pendant onshortcord;doublegold medallion withteal tassels]. Row2 [FIFTH necktie:shortteal scarfknot;SIXTH necktie:simple goldgourd pendant withgreenribbon;FIRST glasses:delicate roundgoldwirepair transparentclearlenses;SECOND glasses:rounded rectangularjade-goldframepair transparentlenses]. Row3 [FIRST earrings pair:smalljadebeads;SECOND earringspair:jade-goldteardrops;THIRD earringspair:tinygoldhoops;extra singlejadehairpin]. In each earringcell drawLEFT andRIGHT earring asgroupedmatchingpair withlarge transparentgap between forface. Eyeglasspieces BOTHlenses andbridge only with fullytransparent clearinteriors, no eyes brows or skin. Allaccessories have coherentfrontview andfine handpaintedgold/jade, no logo/text/frame/background.
